subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold fallback-chain validation into `openclaw models status --probe --all`, or defer the behavior to staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent command contract overlaps provider/auth probes, all-configured-model health checks, and staged model migration, so automation should not choose the UX surface alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface with an optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Make configured-model health probing own this behavior and keep `/models` as a wrapper or discoverability route only if maintainers want chat access.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Treat fallback testing as one step in a broader staged model migration workflow and avoid a standalone command until that flow is designed.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface with an optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided detailed issue guidance and has direct history in the overlapping model status/probe surfaces.
